purpose: Freeze the remaining task-selection, protected-manifest, execution-binding, temporal-pairing, and capture requirements for the future P2-U naturalistic hidden-route primary before any protected P2-U naturalistic system output. This contract does not choose tasks, run systems, change scientific gates, or grant superiority authority.

protected_evaluator_manifest.storage_rule: The protected evaluator manifest and source snapshots must remain outside the repository tree and outside candidate/comparator job custody. A public digest is an integrity seal only and must never be treated as secrecy or as a substitute for access separation.

task_selection.selection_authority: A task curator that does not run or tune either primary arm after protected outputs are opened.

power_and_sample_size_binding.if_underpowered: Do not run an authority-bearing primary on that manifest version. A larger or redesigned manifest requires a new prospective version and seal before any protected output.

must_bind_before_execution: exact ORION candidate git commit and configuration digest
exact donor-complete comparator git commit or source bundle digest and configuration digest
all donor mechanics required by P2_U_BASELINE_CENSUS_V1.json or an explicit pre-outcome unavailability limitation
host/model/checkpoint revision or API snapshot identity and request parameters
retriever/search implementation revisions and endpoint classes
source-access policy plus immutable source snapshot identity where the interface permits snapshots
identical primary-arm task budget vector and enforcement policy
retry count, timeout, backoff, charging, and terminal error mapping
provider/tool common-world health sentinel and machine-checkable invalidity rule
COMPLETE/CLOSED equivalent emitted by each primary arm
primary_execution_manifest.reason_no_shared_capture: Discovery trajectory is part of the P2-U causal outcome.
primary_execution_manifest.system_level_stress_baselines: Run where prospectively bound and feasible, but they do not substitute for the matched donor-complete primary comparator.

temporal_pairing.purpose: Prevent live provider, search-index, or source-world drift from becoming an unmeasured arm difference.
temporal_pairing.if_sequential_arm_order_is_used: Randomize or deterministically counterbalance arm order with a pre-outcome seed and bind the schedule before execution.
temporal_pairing.provider_or_index_drift_beyond_prefrozen: P2_U_PRIMARY_CANNOT_CHECK for the affected paired unit under the V1 validity-floor rules; do not relabel as arm performance unless the frozen sentinel says the common world was healthy.
temporal_pairing.rerun_after_common_world_invalidity: Only a whole paired task unit may be rerun under the exact prefrozen retry/recovery rule before any protected score is opened. Otherwise retire that campaign unit under the frozen invalidity rule.

provider_snapshot_rules.open_weight_model: Bind repository/model revision SHA, tokenizer/config identities, inference-library versions, generation parameters, and executable environment digest before protected execution.
provider_snapshot_rules.remote_api_model: Bind provider, endpoint/model identifier, request schema, fixed decoding/tool parameters, execution date window, retry/timeout policy, and common-world health sentinel. If the provider cannot supply immutable weights, this limitation is explicit rather than disguised as byte identity.
provider_snapshot_rules.retrieval_or_search_api: Bind endpoint class, query schema, result cap/order semantics where controlled, retry/timeout policy, source-access scope, and paired execution window. Provider drift that violates the prefrozen common-world health rule maps to CANNOT_CHECK; arm-specific query/parsing/control failures remain performance.

per_task_per_arm: paired execution window id and arm-order position
raw query or tool-call trace with deterministic redaction policy if required
retrieval response identities or content hashes
unique evidence identity declarations visible to the arm
closure claim and its pre-frozen equivalent
resource ledger by frozen budget dimension
provider/tool health observations available to the worker
all errors, retries, abstentions, and null outputs

issue_650_still_requires: cross-domain replication including a systematic-review-like setting
independent reproduction of route accounting and final decisions
prospectively validated stronger successor search mechanic from a negative, tied, or failure family

anti_laundering: Do not commit hidden route labels or gold closure material into the worker-visible repository and call a hash a secrecy mechanism.
Do not choose or drop tasks, sources, routes, materiality labels, domains, or clusters after a protected arm output is opened.
Do not expand sample size after outcome inspection; a redesigned campaign must receive a new prospective version and seal.
Do not weaken the V1 or V2 efficacy, false-closure, utility, closure-yield, validity, power, or GuardExercise gates.
Do not silently substitute a weaker comparator, a different host, more source access, a different budget, or an easier provider-invalidity mapping after execution begins.
Do not count retries, routes, documents, or repeated traces as independent task n.
Do not allow evaluator-only work to leak into candidate decisions or candidate-side work to disappear from resource accounting.
Do not let live-provider timing or search-index drift become a systematic arm-order advantage.
Do not treat a public benchmark, narrow P2 Wide result, or protocol-only freeze as P2-U superiority evidence.
